summary: Finalized successful opt-in Retina DXMT HiDPI candidate and documentation for commit. `d3d11.hidpiNativeResolution=True` uses the Wine CAMetalLayer backing scale to allocate a physical-size swapchain backbuffer while preserving layer geometry; D3D11 command encoding expands matching full-window logical viewports/scissors 2x. Known limitation documented: brief menu-overlay flicker during fullscreen/borderless transitions before presentation resources settle. Ticket dxm-9jj6. Validation: ARM64EC ninja build succeeded; live game validated. Intended VCS finalization: describe current jj change and create new working copy.
